name: Restart adapter
description: Restarts an enabled adapter on the running venue: stops its workers, offers it its effective configuration again and starts it. Use it on a failed adapter (status 'failed' in venue/adapters) once whatever stopped it starting is fixed, or to have a running adapter start afresh. If it fails again, the adapter stays failed and the job fails with the reason. A disabled adapter is enabled instead. Venue-owned: requires admin/adapter/manage on <venue DID>/adapters.
